thread:
lee: Heads up — want to run a partial unpin of SDK 2.7 -> 2.8 and runtime 4.0.0 for non-critical pools tonight 01:30 UTC. Target: keep sable-3b pinned to runtime 3.x for first two waves.
rachel: +1 but we need clear rollback triggers. propose: 0.8% error spike OR p95 > baseline +40ms for 3m.
kiran: Note: SDK 2.8 changes the grpc keepalive defaults; long-lived client connections may need an update. We should include a compatibility note in release notes.
lee: Good call. Plan: wave1 = canaries (no sable traffic), wave2 = regional test pools (sable excluded), wave3 = global with sable migration next day. Manual gate between waves.
deploybot: Scheduled action: PARTIAL_UNPIN sdk=2.8 runtime=4.0.0 start=2026-08-20T01:30:00Z waves=3 spacing=10m deploy_id=dep_6172812345
ops-bot: Reminder: tag telemetry with "partial_unpin_6172812345" and set alert runbook link: https://internal/runbooks/partial-unpin
[01:35 UTC] deploybot: wave1 started -> canary-us, canary-eu. rolling...
[01:37 UTC] rachel: seeing transient p95 +22ms in canary-us, error_rate steady. continue.
[01:43 UTC] deploybot: wave1 complete. awaiting manual go for wave2.
lee: Hold while devx validates grpc keepalive charm. devx?
devx: Quick smoke passed, but we found one client lib (python-client v0.9) that resets connections at 2m. Recommend back-porting a small retry fix before sable migration.
[01:58 UTC] rachel: manual go for wave2 -> starting in 2m. sable still excluded.
[02:03 UTC] deploybot: wave2 started -> region-asia-1, region-na-3.
[02:06 UTC] ops-bot: Alert rule triggered: error_rate in region-asia-1 = 0.95% (below threshold). monitor.
[02:11 UTC] deploybot: wave2 complete. No BACKOUT_REQUIRED. scheduling wave3 tomorrow to include sable after client fix.
lee: I'll draft release notes: include grpc keepalive change, sable pinning plan, rollback criteria, and customer advisory for python-client v0.9.
rachel: filing follow-up ticket to backport retry fix: OPS-7234.
kiran: will coordinate sable migration timeline once fix lands. thanks team :thumbsup:
